title: Pikku miehiä
summary: "Pikku miehiä" by Louisa May Alcott is a children's novel published in 1871. This sequel to "Little Women" follows Jo Bhaer and her husband as they run an unconventional school at Plumfield. Young orphan Nat Blake arrives to find a place where pillow fights are scheduled, children tend their own gardens, and learning happens through experience rather than strict rules.
